1. Core Philosophy

Neon Vision analytics infrastructure is designed to provide real-time visibility, predictive insights, and autonomous decision loops. Every sub-service, niche, and client tier is mapped to measurable KPIs, creating a closed-loop system that feeds growth, retention, and expansion decisions.

Goals:

Track performance across all 14 services and hidden sub-services

Measure ROI and cost-efficiency per channel

Identify expansion opportunities automatically

Automate alerts for underperformance or opportunities
